## Intra-MOTU Genetic Distance

```{r intra_motu_matrix}
#| echo: false

pal_intra <- carto_pal(7, "Sunset")
ramp_intra <- colorRamp(pal_intra)

get_rgba_palette <- function(val, max_val, ramp_fn, alpha = 0.24) {
    if (is.na(val) || !is.numeric(val) || !is.finite(val)) return("transparent")
    denom <- if (is.na(max_val) || !is.finite(max_val) || max_val <= 0) 1 else max_val
    norm_val <- max(0, min(1, val / denom))
    rgb <- ramp_fn(norm_val)
    sprintf("rgba(%f, %f, %f, %s)", rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3], alpha)
}

calc_motu_stats <- function(mat_sub) {
    n_seq <- nrow(mat_sub)
    if (n_seq <= 1) {
        return(list(n_seq = n_seq, n_pairs = 0, mean = 0, median = 0, min = 0, max = 0, sd = NA_real_, var = NA_real_, se = NA_real_))
    }
    vals <- mat_sub[upper.tri(mat_sub)]
    vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
    n_p <- length(vals)
    if (n_p == 0) {
        return(list(n_seq = n_seq, n_pairs = 0, mean = NA_real_, median = NA_real_, min = NA_real_, max = NA_real_, sd = NA_real_, var = NA_real_, se = NA_real_))
    }
    s_sd <- if (n_p > 1) stats::sd(vals) else NA_real_
    s_var <- if (n_p > 1) stats::var(vals) else NA_real_
    s_se <- if (n_p > 1) s_sd / sqrt(n_p) else NA_real_
    list(
        n_seq = n_seq,
        n_pairs = n_p,
        mean = mean(vals),
        median = stats::median(vals),
        min = min(vals),
        max = max(vals),
        sd = s_sd,
        var = s_var,
        se = s_se
    )
}

fmt_stat <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || !is.finite(x)) "-" else sprintf("%.4f", x)
}

models <- c("raw" = "raw", "K80" = "K80", "JC69" = "JC69", "TN93" = "TN93", "T92" = "T92")
date_str <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

intra_ui_list <- list(
    htmltools::tags$select(
        id = "intraMetricDropdown",
        class = "metric-selector",
        onchange = "toggleMatrixGroup('intraMetricDropdown', 'intra-matrix')",
        htmltools::tags$option(value = "raw", "Uncorrected (p-distance)"),
        htmltools::tags$option(value = "K80", "Kimura 2-P (K80)"),
        htmltools::tags$option(value = "JC69", "Jukes-Cantor (JC69)"),
        htmltools::tags$option(value = "TN93", "Tamura-Nei (TN93)"),
        htmltools::tags$option(value = "T92", "Tamura 3-P (T92)")
    )
)

for (f in fasta_files) {
    if (!file.exists(f)) next
    dna <- read.dna(f, format = "fasta")

    d_raw_dist <- dist.dna(dna, model = "raw", as.matrix = FALSE, pairwise.deletion = TRUE)
    if (any(is.na(d_raw_dist))) {
        max_d <- max(d_raw_dist, na.rm = TRUE)
        d_raw_dist[is.na(d_raw_dist)] <- if (is.infinite(max_d)) 1 else max_d
    }

    hc <- hclust(d_raw_dist, method = "average")
    motu_clusters <- cutree(hc, h = 0.05)

    if (length(fasta_files) > 1) {
        intra_ui_list <- append(intra_ui_list, list(
            htmltools::tags$h3(
                style = "margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 12px; color: var(--tbl-text);",
                paste("File:", basename(f))
            )
        ))
    }

    for (motu_id in sort(unique(motu_clusters))) {
        motu_label <- sprintf("%s-%s", date_str, motu_id)
        anchor_id <- paste0("motu-", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "-", motu_label))
        seqs_in_motu <- names(motu_clusters)[motu_clusters == motu_id]

        model_blocks <- list()

        for (m_name in names(models)) {
        mat <- get_dist_matrix(dna, models[[m_name]])
        mat_sub <- mat[seqs_in_motu, seqs_in_motu, drop = FALSE]
        st <- calc_motu_stats(mat_sub)

        df_mat <- cbind(
            Sequence = seqs_in_motu,
            `rownames<-`(as.data.frame(mat_sub), NULL)
        )

        max_val <- suppressWarnings(max(mat_sub, na.rm = TRUE))
        if (!is.finite(max_val) || max_val == 0) max_val <- 1

        col_defs <- list(
            Sequence = colDef(
                sticky = "left",
                minWidth = 150,
                style = list(fontWeight = "bold", backgroundColor = "var(--tbl-bg)")
            )
        )

        for (cname in seqs_in_motu) {
            col_defs[[cname]] <- colDef(
            minWidth = 85,
            style = function(value) {
                if (is.nan(value) || is.na(value)) return(list(color = "transparent"))
                list(backgroundColor = get_rgba_palette(value, max_val, ramp_intra, 0.24))
            },
            cell = function(value) {
                if (is.nan(value) || is.na(value)) "" else formatC(value, format = "f", digits = 4)
            }
            )
        }

        tbl <- if (m_name == "raw") {
            reactable(
                df_mat,
                theme = dynamic_theme,
                rownames = FALSE,
                pagination = nrow(df_mat) > 40,
                defaultPageSize = 40,
                sortable = FALSE,
                compact = TRUE,
                fullWidth = FALSE,
                columns = col_defs,
                style = list(fontSize = "13px")
            )
        } else {
            hdr_cells <- lapply(names(df_mat), function(col_nm) {
                htmltools::tags$th(
                    style = "padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--tbl-border); background: var(--tbl-stripe); white-space: nowrap;",
                    col_nm
                )
            })
            body_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_mat)), function(r_i) {
                tds <- lapply(seq_along(names(df_mat)), function(c_i) {
                    val <- df_mat[[c_i]][r_i]
                    if (c_i == 1) {
                        htmltools::tags$td(
                            style = "padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--tbl-border); font-weight: bold; white-space: nowrap;",
                            as.character(val)
                        )
                    } else {
                        bg <- if (is.nan(val) || is.na(val)) "transparent" else get_rgba_palette(val, max_val, ramp_intra, 0.24)
                        txt <- if (is.nan(val) || is.na(val)) "" else formatC(val, format = "f", digits = 4)
                        htmltools::tags$td(
                            style = sprintf("padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--tbl-border); background-color: %s; white-space: nowrap;", bg),
                            txt
                        )
                    }
                })
                htmltools::tags$tr(tds)
            })
            htmltools::tags$table(
                style = "border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; color: var(--tbl-text);",
                htmltools::tags$thead(htmltools::tags$tr(hdr_cells)),
                htmltools::tags$tbody(body_rows)
            )
        }

        stats_strip <- htmltools::div(
            style = "display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; padding: 6px 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; background-color: var(--tbl-stripe); border: 1px solid var(--tbl-border); border-left: 3px solid var(--tbl-accent); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--tbl-text);",
            htmltools::span(htmltools::strong("Pairs: "), st$n_pairs),
            htmltools::span(htmltools::strong("Mean: "), fmt_stat(st$mean)),
            htmltools::span(htmltools::strong("Median: "), fmt_stat(st$median)),
            htmltools::span(htmltools::strong("Min: "), fmt_stat(st$min)),
            htmltools::span(htmltools::strong("Max: "), fmt_stat(st$max)),
            htmltools::span(htmltools::strong("SD: "), fmt_stat(st$sd)),
            htmltools::span(htmltools::strong("Var: "), fmt_stat(st$var)),
            htmltools::span(htmltools::strong("SE: "), fmt_stat(st$se))
        )

        display_style <- if (m_name == "raw") "display: block;" else "display: none;"
        model_blocks <- append(model_blocks, list(
            htmltools::div(
            class = sprintf("intra-matrix intra-matrix-%s", m_name),
            style = display_style,
            stats_strip,
            htmltools::div(class = "matrix-wrapper", style = "margin-top: 6px;", tbl)
            )
        ))
        }

        motu_block <- htmltools::div(
        id = anchor_id,
        class = "motu-section-block",
        style = "margin-top: 28px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--tbl-border); scroll-margin-top: 20px;",
        htmltools::tags$h4(
            style = "margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--tbl-accent);",
            paste0("MOTU: ", motu_label, " "),
            htmltools::span(
            style = "font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--tbl-text); opacity: 0.8;",
            sprintf("(%d sequence%s)", length(seqs_in_motu), if (length(seqs_in_motu) == 1) "" else "s")
            )
        ),
        model_blocks
        )

        intra_ui_list <- append(intra_ui_list, list(motu_block))
    }
}
```

## Inter-MOTU Genetic Distance

```{r inter_motu_matrix}
#| echo: false

pal_inter <- carto_pal(7, "TealGrn")
ramp_inter <- colorRamp(pal_inter)
ramp_diag <- colorRamp(carto_pal(7, "Sunset"))

inter_ui_list <- list(
    htmltools::tags$select(
        id = "interMetricDropdown",
        class = "metric-selector",
        onchange = "toggleMatrixGroup('interMetricDropdown', 'inter-matrix')",
        htmltools::tags$option(value = "raw", "Uncorrected (p-distance)"),
        htmltools::tags$option(value = "K80", "Kimura 2-P (K80)"),
        htmltools::tags$option(value = "JC69", "Jukes-Cantor (JC69)"),
        htmltools::tags$option(value = "TN93", "Tamura-Nei (TN93)"),
        htmltools::tags$option(value = "T92", "Tamura 3-P (T92)")
    )
)

for (f in fasta_files) {
    if (!file.exists(f)) next
    dna <- read.dna(f, format = "fasta")

    d_raw_dist <- dist.dna(dna, model = "raw", as.matrix = FALSE, pairwise.deletion = TRUE)
    if (any(is.na(d_raw_dist))) {
        max_d <- max(d_raw_dist, na.rm = TRUE)
        d_raw_dist[is.na(d_raw_dist)] <- if (is.infinite(max_d)) 1 else max_d
    }

    hc <- hclust(d_raw_dist, method = "average")
    motu_clusters <- cutree(hc, h = 0.05)
    unique_motus <- sort(unique(motu_clusters))
    motu_labels <- sprintf("%s-%s", date_str, unique_motus)
    n_m <- length(unique_motus)

    if (length(fasta_files) > 1) {
            inter_ui_list <- append(inter_ui_list, list(
            htmltools::tags$h3(
                style = "margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 12px; color: var(--tbl-text);",
                paste("File:", basename(f))
            )
        ))
    }

    for (m_name in names(models)) {
        mat <- get_dist_matrix(dna, models[[m_name]])
        inter_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_m, ncol = n_m, dimnames = list(motu_labels, motu_labels))

        for (i in seq_len(n_m)) {
            seqs_i <- names(motu_clusters)[motu_clusters == unique_motus[i]]
            for (j in seq_len(n_m)) {
                seqs_j <- names(motu_clusters)[motu_clusters == unique_motus[j]]
                sub_block <- mat[seqs_i, seqs_j, drop = FALSE]

                if (i < j) {
                    val <- suppressWarnings(max(sub_block, na.rm = TRUE))
                } else if (i > j) {
                    val <- suppressWarnings(min(sub_block, na.rm = TRUE))
                } else {
                    val <- suppressWarnings(max(sub_block, na.rm = TRUE))
                }
                inter_mat[i, j] <- if (is.finite(val)) val else NA_real_
            }
        }

        df_inter <- cbind(
            MOTU = motu_labels,
            `rownames<-`(as.data.frame(inter_mat), NULL)
        )

        off_diag_vals <- inter_mat[row(inter_mat) != col(inter_mat)]
        diag_vals <- diag(inter_mat)
        max_inter_val <- suppressWarnings(max(off_diag_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
        max_diag_val <- suppressWarnings(max(diag_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
        if (!is.finite(max_inter_val) || max_inter_val == 0) max_inter_val <- 1
        if (!is.finite(max_diag_val) || max_diag_val == 0) max_diag_val <- 1

        col_defs <- list(
            MOTU = colDef(
                sticky = "left",
                minWidth = 140,
                style = list(fontWeight = "bold", backgroundColor = "var(--tbl-bg)")
            )
        )

        for (j_idx in seq_along(motu_labels)) {
            m_col <- motu_labels[j_idx]
            col_defs[[m_col]] <- local({
                col_j <- j_idx
                colDef(
                    minWidth = 100,
                    style = function(value, index) {
                        if (is.nan(value) || is.na(value)) return(list(color = "transparent"))
                        if (index == col_j) {
                            list(
                                backgroundColor = get_rgba_palette(value, max_diag_val, ramp_diag, 0.28),
                                fontWeight = "bold"
                            )
                        } else {
                            list(
                                backgroundColor = get_rgba_palette(value, max_inter_val, ramp_inter, 0.24)
                            )
                        }
                    },
                    cell = function(value) {
                        if (is.nan(value) || is.na(value)) "-" else formatC(value, format = "f", digits = 4)
                    }
                )
            })
        }

        tbl <- if (m_name == "raw") {
            reactable(
                df_inter,
                theme = dynamic_theme,
                rownames = FALSE,
                pagination = nrow(df_inter) > 40,
                defaultPageSize = 40,
                sortable = FALSE,
                compact = TRUE,
                fullWidth = FALSE,
                columns = col_defs,
                style = list(fontSize = "13px")
            )
        } else {
            hdr_cells <- lapply(names(df_inter), function(col_nm) {
                htmltools::tags$th(
                    style = "padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--tbl-border); background: var(--tbl-stripe); white-space: nowrap;",
                    col_nm
                )
            })
            body_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_inter)), function(r_i) {
                tds <- lapply(seq_along(names(df_inter)), function(c_i) {
                    val <- df_inter[[c_i]][r_i]
                    if (c_i == 1) {
                        htmltools::tags$td(
                            style = "padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--tbl-border); font-weight: bold; white-space: nowrap;",
                            as.character(val)
                        )
                    } else {
                        is_diag <- (r_i == (c_i - 1L))
                        bg <- if (is.nan(val) || is.na(val)) {
                            "transparent"
                        } else if (is_diag) {
                            get_rgba_palette(val, max_diag_val, ramp_diag, 0.28)
                        } else {
                            get_rgba_palette(val, max_inter_val, ramp_inter, 0.24)
                        }
                        txt <- if (is.nan(val) || is.na(val)) "-" else formatC(val, format = "f", digits = 4)
                        weight_css <- if (is_diag) "font-weight: bold;" else ""
                        htmltools::tags$td(
                            style = sprintf(
                                "padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--tbl-border); background-color: %s; %s white-space: nowrap;",
                                bg, weight_css
                            ),
                            txt
                        )
                    }
                })
                htmltools::tags$tr(tds)
            })
            htmltools::tags$table(
                style = "border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; color: var(--tbl-text);",
                htmltools::tags$thead(htmltools::tags$tr(hdr_cells)),
                htmltools::tags$tbody(body_rows)
            )
        }

        legend_box <- htmltools::div(
            style = "margin-top: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; background-color: var(--tbl-stripe); border: 1px solid var(--tbl-border); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--tbl-text); display: inline-block;",
            htmltools::strong("Matrix Legend: "),
            htmltools::span(style = "margin-left: 8px;", htmltools::strong("Upper Triangle:"), " Maximum inter-MOTU distance (Teal-Green scale) • "),
            htmltools::span(htmltools::strong("Lower Triangle:"), " Minimum inter-MOTU distance (Teal-Green scale) • "),
            htmltools::span(htmltools::strong("Diagonal (bold):"), " Maximum intra-MOTU distance (Sunset scale)")
        )

        display_style <- if (m_name == "raw") "display: block;" else "display: none;"
        inter_ui_list <- append(inter_ui_list, list(
            htmltools::div(
                class = sprintf("inter-matrix inter-matrix-%s matrix-wrapper", m_name),
                style = display_style,
                tbl,
                legend_box
            )
        ))
    }
}

htmltools::tagList(inter_ui_list)
```

## MOTU Dendrogram

```{r motu_dendrogram}
#| echo: false

compute_bootstrap_support <- function(dna, ref_hc, n_boot = 100L, seed = 42L) {
    ref_phylo <- ape::as.phylo(ref_hc)
    n_tips <- length(ref_phylo$tip.label)
    n_int <- ref_phylo$Nnode

    if (n_tips < 3 || n_int < 1 || !is.matrix(dna) || ncol(dna) == 0) {
        return(rep(NA_real_, max(0L, n_int)))
    }

    ref_parts <- ape::prop.part(ref_phylo)
    ref_labels <- ref_phylo$tip.label
    ref_clades <- lapply(seq_len(n_int), function(idx) {
        sort(ref_labels[ref_parts[[idx]]])
    })

    get_clade_signatures <- function(tr) {
        tr_parts <- ape::prop.part(tr)
        tr_labels <- tr$tip.label
        lapply(seq_len(tr$Nnode), function(idx) {
            sort(tr_labels[tr_parts[[idx]]])
        })
    }

    set.seed(seed)
    support_counts <- integer(n_int)
    n_sites <- ncol(dna)

    for (b in seq_len(n_boot)) {
        boot_idx <- sample.int(n_sites, size = n_sites, replace = TRUE)
        dna_b <- dna[, boot_idx, drop = FALSE]

        d_b <- tryCatch(
            ape::dist.dna(dna_b, model = "raw", as.matrix = FALSE, pairwise.deletion = TRUE),
            error = function(e) NULL
        )
        if (is.null(d_b)) next

        if (any(is.na(d_b))) {
            max_d_b <- max(d_b, na.rm = TRUE)
            d_b[is.na(d_b)] <- if (!is.finite(max_d_b)) 1 else max_d_b
        }

        hc_b <- tryCatch(stats::hclust(d_b, method = "average"), error = function(e) NULL)
        if (is.null(hc_b)) next

        b_clades <- get_clade_signatures(ape::as.phylo(hc_b))
        for (k in seq_len(n_int)) {
            target_set <- ref_clades[[k]]
            if (any(vapply(b_clades, function(cl) identical(cl, target_set), logical(1)))) {
                support_counts[k] <- support_counts[k] + 1L
            }
        }
    }

    round(100 * support_counts / n_boot)
}

build_phylo_ggplot <- function(phylo_obj, hc_order, tip_cols, boot_support, max_depth, n_tips) {
    edge <- phylo_obj$edge
    edge_len <- phylo_obj$edge.length
    n_nodes <- n_tips + phylo_obj$Nnode
    root_node <- n_tips + 1L

    # Depth from root in full pairwise distance units (2 * edge.length for hclust UPGMA)
    depth_from_root <- numeric(n_nodes)
    calc_x <- function(nd) {
        ch_rows <- which(edge[, 1] == nd)
        for (r_idx in ch_rows) {
            child_nd <- edge[r_idx, 2]
            depth_from_root[child_nd] <<- depth_from_root[nd] + (2 * edge_len[r_idx])
            if (child_nd > n_tips) calc_x(child_nd)
        }
    }
    calc_x(root_node)

    total_depth <- max(depth_from_root)
    x_pos <- total_depth - depth_from_root

    # Y coordinate: hc_order[1] at top (n_tips), hc_order[n_tips] at bottom (1)
    y_pos <- numeric(n_nodes)
    y_pos[hc_order] <- rev(seq_len(n_tips))

    calc_y <- function(nd) {
        if (nd <= n_tips) return(y_pos[nd])
        ch <- edge[edge[, 1] == nd, 2]
        ch_ys <- vapply(ch, calc_y, numeric(1))
        y_pos[nd] <<- mean(ch_ys)
        y_pos[nd]
    }
    calc_y(root_node)

    horiz_df <- tibble::tibble(
        x = x_pos[edge[, 1]],
        xend = x_pos[edge[, 2]],
        y = y_pos[edge[, 2]],
        yend = y_pos[edge[, 2]]
    )

    vert_df <- purrr::map_dfr(unique(edge[, 1]), function(parent_nd) {
        ch <- edge[edge[, 1] == parent_nd, 2]
        tibble::tibble(
            x = x_pos[parent_nd],
            xend = x_pos[parent_nd],
            y = min(y_pos[ch]),
            yend = max(y_pos[ch])
        )
    })

    tips_df <- tibble::tibble(
        x = x_pos[seq_len(n_tips)],
        y = y_pos[seq_len(n_tips)],
        label = phylo_obj$tip.label,
        col = tip_cols
    )

    boot_threshold <- 70L
    boot_df <- if (length(boot_support) == phylo_obj$Nnode) {
        int_nodes <- (n_tips + 1L):n_nodes
        tibble::tibble(
            x = x_pos[int_nodes],
            y = y_pos[int_nodes],
            sup = boot_support
        ) |>
            dplyr::filter(!is.na(sup), sup >= boot_threshold) |>
            dplyr::mutate(txt = sprintf("%d", sup))
    } else {
        tibble::tibble(x = numeric(0), y = numeric(0), txt = character(0))
    }

    max_lbl_len <- max(nchar(tips_df$label), na.rm = TRUE)
    # Since x-axis is reversed (max_depth on left -> 0 at tips -> negative values to the right for labels):
    x_right_pad <- -max(max_depth * (0.18 + max_lbl_len * 0.015), 0.08)

    p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggplot2::geom_segment(
            data = vert_df,
            ggplot2::aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend),
            color = "#9aa0a6",
            linewidth = 0.7
        ) +
        ggplot2::geom_segment(
            data = horiz_df,
            ggplot2::aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend),
            color = "#9aa0a6",
            linewidth = 0.7
        ) +
        ggplot2::geom_text(
            data = tips_df,
            ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, color = I(col)),
            hjust = -0.02,
            vjust = 0.35,
            size = 3.1
        )

    if (nrow(boot_df) > 0) {
        p <- p + ggplot2::geom_text(
            data = boot_df,
            ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = txt),
            hjust = 1.15,
            vjust = -0.25,
            size = 2.6,
            color = "#2da44e"
        )
    }

    if (is.finite(max_depth) && max_depth >= 0.05) {
        p <- p + ggplot2::geom_vline(
            xintercept = 0.05,
            linetype = "dashed",
            color = "#cf222e",
            linewidth = 0.75
        )
    }

    x_left_bound <- total_depth * 1.06
    x_breaks <- pretty(c(0, total_depth))
    x_breaks <- x_breaks[x_breaks >= 0 & x_breaks <= x_left_bound]

    p +
        ggplot2::scale_x_reverse(breaks = x_breaks, expand = c(0, 0)) +
        ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
            xlim = c(x_left_bound, x_right_pad),
            ylim = c(0.5, n_tips + 0.5),
            clip = "on"
        ) +
        ggplot2::labs(
            title = NULL,
            x = "Genetic Distance (p-distance)",
            y = NULL
        ) +
        ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
        ggplot2::theme(
            axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
            panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(color = "#57606a"),
            axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(color = "#57606a"),
            plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 14, r = 18, b = 12, l = 14),
            panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#ffffff", color = NA),
            plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "#ffffff", color = NA)
        )
}

dendro_ui_list <- list()
n_boot_reps <- 100L

for (f in fasta_files) {
    if (!file.exists(f)) next
    dna <- read.dna(f, format = "fasta")

    if (nrow(dna) < 2) {
        dendro_ui_list <- append(dendro_ui_list, list(
            htmltools::tags$p(
                style = "color: var(--tbl-text); font-style: italic;",
                sprintf("Not enough sequences in %s to draw a dendrogram.", basename(f))
            )
        ))
        next
    }

    d_raw_dist <- dist.dna(dna, model = "raw", as.matrix = FALSE, pairwise.deletion = TRUE)
    if (any(is.na(d_raw_dist))) {
        max_d <- max(d_raw_dist, na.rm = TRUE)
        d_raw_dist[is.na(d_raw_dist)] <- if (is.infinite(max_d)) 1 else max_d
    }

    hc <- hclust(d_raw_dist, method = "average")
    motu_clusters <- cutree(hc, h = 0.05)
    boot_support <- compute_bootstrap_support(dna, hc, n_boot = n_boot_reps, seed = 42L)

    hc_plot <- hc
    hc_plot$labels <- sprintf("%s [%s-%s]", hc$labels, date_str, motu_clusters[hc$labels])

    phylo_obj <- ape::as.phylo(hc_plot)
    n_tips <- length(phylo_obj$tip.label)
    fig_h <- max(5, min(24, n_tips * 0.28 + 1.8))

    n_motus <- length(unique(motu_clusters))
    motu_pal <- carto_pal(max(3, min(12, n_motus)), "Bold")
    tip_cols <- motu_pal[(motu_clusters[hc$labels] - 1) %% length(motu_pal) + 1]
    max_depth <- max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(phylo_obj))

    title_txt <- sprintf(
        "UPGMA Dendrogram (Uncorrected p-distance, MOTU cutoff h = 0.05, %d bootstraps)%s",
        n_boot_reps,
        if (length(fasta_files) > 1) paste0(" - ", basename(f)) else ""
    )

    gg_tree <- build_phylo_ggplot(phylo_obj, hc$order, tip_cols, boot_support, max_depth, n_tips)

    png_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
    grDevices::png(
        png_file,
        width = 2400,
        height = max(800L, as.integer(round(fig_h * 180))),
        res = 220,
        bg = "white"
    )
    tryCatch(print(gg_tree), finally = grDevices::dev.off())
    img_uri <- base64enc::dataURI(file = png_file, mime = "image/png")
    unlink(png_file)

    dendro_card <- htmltools::div(
        style = "width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; padding: 18px 20px; background-color: var(--tbl-bg); border: 1px solid var(--tbl-border); border-radius: 6px; margin-top: 12px;",
        htmltools::tags$h4(
            style = "margin: 0 0 12px 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--tbl-accent);",
            title_txt
        ),
        htmltools::div(
            style = "padding: 10px; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid var(--tbl-border); border-radius: 4px;",
            htmltools::tags$img(
                src = img_uri,
                style = "width: 100%; max-width: 1400px; height: auto; display: block; margin: 0 auto;"
            )
        ),
        htmltools::div(
            style = "margin-top: 10px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--tbl-text); opacity: 0.85;",
            sprintf(
                "Tip colors correspond to assigned MOTU clusters (h = 0.05 average-linkage UPGMA clustering on uncorrected p-distance; red dashed line indicates the 5%% divergence threshold from tips when within tree depth). Internal node values show branch support across %d site-resampling bootstrap replicates. Supports under 70 are not shown.",
                n_boot_reps
            )
        )
    )

    dendro_ui_list <- append(dendro_ui_list, list(dendro_card))
}

htmltools::tagList(dendro_ui_list)
```

```{=html}
<style>

<script>
function toggleMatrixGroup(selectId, classPrefix) {
  var selected = document.getElementById(selectId).value;
  var allMatrices = document.getElementsByClassName(classPrefix);
  for (var i = 0; i < allMatrices.length; i++) {
    allMatrices[i].style.display = "none";
  }
  var active = document.getElementsByClassName(classPrefix + "-" + selected);
  for (var i = 0; i < active.length; i++) {
    active[i].style.display = "block";
  }
}
</script>
```
